Title: Q: Stranger Among Us and Shuffling

Messages.Author: Nystulc
Messages.Body:
Two Bloodlines crypt-search cards, Stranger Among Us and Coroner's Contact, say
nothing about shuffling your crypt afterwards, contrasting with Recruitment and
Summon the Serpent. Is this how it is supposed to be; or are we going to get
some errata?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Shuffle afterward.
